name: Soothing Longedge
description: Stand with the blade drawn back behind the hip and sense the whole arc of the coming sweep.

name: Glaiveswat
description: Throw the hip forward so the arm follows and the blade cuts an even arc through the target.

name: Curvecut Stalk
description: Cross the rear foot over the lead as the sweep begins to add a full pace of reach to the arc.

name: Glaiveprop
description: Catch an oncoming blade on the shaft as the sweep rises and carry it up and over the shoulder.

name: Brutal Guardlug
description: Drop the body to one knee and sweep the blade along the ground to take the legs.

name: Hungry Ferrulecap
description: Let qi follow the blade around the arc so the edge cuts harder at the end of the sweep than at the start.

name: Bold Bladespine
description: Turn in place with a flat qi-edged sweep to cut every attacker standing within the glaive's reach.

name: Crookbandage
description: Turn the lead hand palm-up on the shaft and feel how the blade now hangs behind the wrist.

name: Brutal Curvetip
description: Slide the rear hand toward the blade for a short cut and back toward the butt for a long one.

name: Bendthwack
description: Hew backward under the arm with the grip reversed so the edge catches a foe who has slipped behind.

name: Crookbarrier
description: Parry with the shaft held palm-up so the blow is lifted over the arm and not into it.

name: Ducking Windrake
description: Change from forward to reverse grip during a single step so the foe cannot time the swap.

name: Reavehasp
description: Slide a hand down the haft to press a grabbed weapon against the body and hold it there.

name: Lurching Tangheel
description: Swap grips at the top of the swing so qi arrives from an angle the opponent was not guarding.

name: Gripping Longcut
description: Pull the reversed shaft across an opponent's wrist with a pulse of qi that spins the weapon from the hand.

name: Attentive Spineedge
description: Square the shoulders to the foe and sense which of the three guard lines is open.

name: Rigid Glavesocket
description: Hold the shaft slanted above the head so a blow from above slides off the curved blade.

name: Armored Glaiveblade
description: Swing the blade down and across to knock a low cut aside with the heel of the edge.

name: Wild Tangheel
description: Turn from a held guard into a cut by rolling the shaft over the lead hand in one motion.

name: Cutterhasp
description: Brace the guard with a thickened field of qi along the shaft so heavier blows break against it.

name: Slicefall Swat
description: Turn the guard into a slash the moment the foe's blow ends, with qi flooding the edge.

name: Cooling Longedge
description: Count the breaths it takes for qi to travel from the rear hand to the blade tip.

name: Fierce Cutbelly
description: Cut so qi reaches the curved edge just as it meets the target and not before.

name: Bladespine Cordial
description: Shift qi from the edge to the spine between a cut and a parry in the same stroke.

name: Wild Edgeswing
description: Thrust with qi held back until the last finger's width so the foe reads no warning.

name: Bendbarrier
description: Run qi through the shaft to stiffen it as a blade strikes and so turn the blow.

name: Springing Guardlug
description: Step so that no qi is spent at all and the whole reserve is kept for the blade.

name: Glaivescorer
description: Surge qi into the edge at the instant of contact to hew through a shield rim or a haft.

name: Wild Curvetip
description: Spread qi as a thin sheet along the curve and sweep it to clear a crowd standing close.

name: Burdening Cutbelly
description: Strike the spine against a shield so the hum of qi numbs the arm that holds it.

name: Humcutter
description: Judge the closing speed of a horse by the dust at its hooves and set the feet to meet it.

name: Reavethwack
description: Draw the curved edge across the back of a horse's leg as it passes the lunge.

name: Cutterswat
description: Hew at the rider's thigh and the saddle girth from below as the horse comes level.

name: Reaveswerve
description: Step off the line of a charging horse and let its shoulder pass the shaft.

name: Padded Spineedge
description: Raise the shaft to turn a lance or sabre swung down from the saddle.

name: Brass Glaiveblade
description: Plant the butt at the foot and angle the blade up so a charge is met by the point.

name: Stalling Reave
description: Hook a rein with the blade's curve and hold it so the horse is dragged round off its line.

name: Vicious Ferrulecap
description: Cut the horse's shoulder with a qi-heavy edge so the beast shies and breaks its line.

name: Dire Slicefall
description: Sweep across the front of a charge with qi along the edge to cut the lead horses' legs.

name: Gall Curvecut
description: Catch a rider's leg with the heel of the blade and pull with qi to topple him from the saddle.

name: Lunar Glaiveblade
description: Settle the weight back over the rear leg and sense the line along which the pull will run.

name: Static Windrake
description: Lay the curved edge on the target and pull it backward so the cut opens as it comes.

name: Gall Edgeswing
description: Catch the opponent's ankle behind the blade's curve and pull to unbalance a charging step.

name: Claybend
description: Lean back as a blow lands and let the shaft take it a hand's width from the body.

name: Rill Reave
description: Pull the blade and the body back together in one step so the retreat is also a cut.

name: Draught Cutbelly
description: Pull the edge through the target with qi gathered at the belly so the slash rips deep.

name: Gall Bladespine
description: Draw the blade down the foe's shaft with qi in the curve and tear the weapon from his hands.

name: Lunar Guardlug
description: Test the ground with the lead foot for slope and slickness before committing any weight.

name: Brawn Ferrulecap
description: Advance in a triangle, lead foot out then rear foot across, to approach without a straight line.

name: Brawn Edgeswing
description: Walk in a crescent around an opponent while the blade tip keeps pointing at his throat.

name: Wild Curvecut
description: Stamp the lead foot to fix the opponent's eyes and lunge a cut in the same breath.

name: Shard Tangheel
description: Drag the lead foot back while the shaft covers the body, giving ground without opening the guard.

name: Brawncrook
description: Plant the butt and hop the body over a low sweep aimed at the legs.

name: Prowling Reave
description: Spring forward with qi in the legs and close a gap of four paces before the foe resets.

name: Draught Curvetip
description: Land a hewing cut at the end of a long step so the whole run drives the edge.

name: Recall Glavesocket
description: Hang the shaft from one finger to find its point of balance before any drill.

name: Poisebend
description: Roll the shaft along the arm so a blow slides along it and off the end.

name: Keen Spineedge
description: Smash the butt end back into a pursuer's ribs while turning to face forward.

name: Lassoing Windrake
description: Wrap the shaft under an opponent's arm and slide it to pin the elbow.

name: Blankglaive
description: Pass the hands one over the other down the shaft to extend a thrust a full forearm further.

name: Twirling Longedge
description: Twirl the shaft quickly in front of the body so thrown stones and darts are knocked aside.

name: Harsh Slicefall
description: Harden the shaft with qi and strike with its middle so the blow breaks bone through cloth.

name: Glaivescreen
description: Lock the shaft across two crossed weapons with qi and press until both are held down.

name: Embercrook
description: Flex the shaft with qi so it whips back and strikes with the butt after a parry.

name: Cuttertonic
description: Loosen both hands on the shaft and sense the point where the blade's weight will carry the wheel.

name: Stern Glavesocket
description: Wheel the blade high over the head and bring it down in a long cutting arc.

name: Rooted Cutbelly
description: Keep the glaive turning in front of the body so each incoming blade is flicked away.

name: Rill Curvecut
description: Step to the side as the wheel ends so the foe's counter finds only empty air.

name: Brassbend
description: Keep the blade wheeling with qi so each pass cuts and the next pass is already coming.

name: Padded Ferrulecap
description: Spin the glaive fast enough that qi forms a rotating screen against arrows and thrown spears.
